initialExam.title: Haryana Police Constable 2026
initialExam.description: Haryana Police Constable recruitment for male and female constable posts in Haryana state police force.
initialExam.syllabus: GK, Current Affairs, Haryana GK, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, Hindi, English, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Written Test: 100 questions, 80 marks, 90 minutes. Physical Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Knowledge Test → Physical Screening Test → Document Verification → Medical → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit hssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Uniform allowance, Pension
